summary: Space Mission Survival is an interactive 3D space adventure game that allows players to experience the excitement and challenges of space exploration. Players navigate a spacecraft through different space environments, avoid obstacles, collect essential resources and complete mission objectives. The game combines exploration, survival mechanics and interactive gameplay to create an engaging experience. It also incorporates authentic NASA space imagery and educational information to encourage curiosity about planets, galaxies and space exploration. The project aims to make space science more accessible and enjoyable through gaming.
details: Space Mission Survival is an interactive 3D space adventure game where players control a spacecraft, navigate through space, avoid obstacles, collect resources and complete mission objectives. Developed using GDevelop and GD.games, the game combines exploration, survival elements and engaging visuals to introduce players to the excitement and challenges of space exploration. It aims to encourage curiosity about space science while developing decision-making and problem-solving skills through gameplay. The project creatively transforms space exploration into an interactive experience using space-themed graphics, simple controls and mission-based challenges. During development, the team focused on user-friendliness, educational value, visual appeal, accessibility and technical feasibility. NASA imagery and educational resources may also be incorporated with appropriate acknowledgement.
